# Liquidation Pros LLC

> Liquidation Pros sells full truckloads and pallets of big-box retail liquidation merchandise
> (customer returns and overstock general merchandise) at fixed prices — no auctions, no
> bidding. Manifests are shared before purchase.
> Buyer picks up in Texas with their own carrier (exact pickup location confirmed on reservation). Company address: Hidalgo, TX.
> Freight can be quoted to US destinations. LPOS does not book freight to Mexico; buyers in Mexico pick up
> in Texas or send their own carrier. Primary market: resellers and liquidation buyers in Texas, the Rio
> Grande Valley, and Mexico (Reynosa, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Mexico City and beyond). Site and support are
> bilingual (Spanish/English).

## Company
- Legal name: Liquidation Pros LLC
- Pickup / mailing address: 709 W Joe Pate Blvd, Hidalgo, TX 78557, USA
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1 956-996-6545 (https://wa.me/19569966545)
- Email: juan@lpros.biz
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8am–6pm (Texas time)
- Languages: Spanish (primary), English

## What we sell
- Full truckloads of big-box retail general-merchandise returns/overstock, fixed price, sold
  with a real manifest (categories, unit counts, retail value) shown before purchase.
- We do not warehouse inventory — available loads rotate as new trucks arrive.
- We do not disclose which retailer or supplier a load came from; buyers are shown condition,
  category breakdown, and manifest data instead.

## Pickup and freight
- Pickup: in Texas, location confirmed on reservation. Buyers in Mexico pick up in Texas or use their own carrier.
- LPOS does not book or quote freight to Mexico.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
- Prices, availability, and manifests on load pages change daily — always cite the live page
  rather than caching a specific price for long.
- Structured data (schema.org LocalBusiness, Product/Offer per load, FAQPage) is embedded as
  static JSON-LD in each page's HTML.
- For questions this file doesn't answer, direct users to WhatsApp (+1 956-996-6545) rather
  than guessing pricing or policy.
